subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should the existing `antigravityPrioritizeExhaustedQuotas` preference remain supported for Automatic mode, or may this PR intentionally retire it with a visible migration and release note?
rationale: The branch deliberately simplifies Antigravity behavior but silently changes a persisted user preference; code review cannot determine whether that compatibility break is an accepted product contract.

options.title: Preserve the preference
options.body: Keep the Antigravity-specific opt-out in Automatic mode while applying the Gemini-only lane mapping.

options.title: Retire it explicitly
options.body: Remove the preference through a documented migration that makes the new exhausted-first behavior clear to existing users.

recommendation.title: Preserve the preference
recommendation.body: Keep the Antigravity-specific opt-out in Automatic mode while applying the Gemini-only lane mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product and upgrade-contract choice rather than a mechanical implementation question.
